tableLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.
SYSTEM: Neural interface stable. Text overlay enabled.
You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.
✦ Nadia has found something — Everybody's Friend. Days of silver_tongue and gossip_network side by side, and now they move as one. (everybodys_friend: villager synergy discovered)
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
★ Deeper knowledge: Maypop. Parts: ripe fruit only (wrinkled, yellow, fragrant). Unripe = bitter and nauseating. (Yield +50%). Use unlocked: food: ripe wrinkled fruit — sweet-tart pulp.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Harvest Table. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 80. I've been watching what you're becoming, little living. Names for your shelf: Beard Moss, Harvest Table. What they DO — that's still yours to learn."
(The pods need an answer. Speak for them — it will cost you — or let the segment play.)
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Kenji.
The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the southeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
🧳 Emberhold has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Zoe.
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table II bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Beloved. Strangers ask for your blessing. You don't know what to do with that.

At the fire, someone does the math out loud — the pods' life-support draw, against the pantry. "I'm just saying. That power could be food." Nobody looks at the mourners. Everybody knows where the mourners are sitting.
(Defend the pods — it will cost real food — or let the question hang.)
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table II. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
You overhear it at the fire, and stop pretending not to listen. Riders from The Red Table are telling the deer story again — with your name attached this time.
🧳 A traveler says Stonebridge burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table II is the new fire.)
The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Meera speaks at Ashford's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
A runner from The Red Table II, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
You give Ashford 1,932 kcal from Haven's bins — real food, honestly counted. Grace weeps, openly. "The fire network. That's what it's FOR." (Trust +4. They owe you — the ledger remembers.)
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the northeast called The Red Table II. The region is bigger than your fire.
(The pods need an answer. Speak for them — it will cost you — or let the segment play.)
